PRIVACY POLICY

How Knight Fitness Lawnton collects, uses, stores and protects your personal information.

This is a general privacy policy based on the Australian Privacy Principles. It has not yet been reviewed by Knight Fitness Lawnton. Please check that it matches how the business actually handles information before relying on it.

Last updated: 23 November 2026

Knight Fitness Lawnton ("Knight Fitness", "we", "us", "our") runs a coaching gym at 664 Gympie Road, Lawnton QLD 4501. We respect your privacy and handle personal information in line with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs). This policy explains what we collect, why, and the choices you have.

1. What personal information we collect

We only collect information that is reasonably necessary for our services. Depending on how you deal with us, this may include:

  • Contact details: your name, mobile number and email address.
  • Enquiry details: the program you're interested in, your preferred times, and anything you tell us in a message or on a call.
  • Membership details: date of birth, emergency contact, membership and attendance records, and billing details.
  • Health and fitness information: injuries, medical conditions, pre-exercise screening answers, goals, measurements and progress photos. This is sensitive information, and we only collect it with your consent and where it's needed to coach you safely.
  • Information about children: where a parent or guardian enrols a young person (for example in Young Knights), we collect the details the parent or guardian provides.
  • Website and device information: pages visited, the referring site, browser and device type, approximate location and similar data collected by cookies and analytics tools (see section 7).

You can make a general enquiry without giving your full name where that's practical (APP 2), but we'll need a way to contact you to reply.

2. How we collect it

We collect personal information directly from you when you fill in an enquiry or booking form, call, message or email us, sign up for a membership or challenge, complete a screening form, or talk to a coach. We may also receive information from service providers who run our booking, payment and messaging systems, or from social media platforms when you contact us through them.

3. Why we collect, use and disclose it

  • to reply to your enquiry and help you choose the right program;
  • to book sessions, manage your membership and take payments;
  • to coach you safely, adapt training to injuries or conditions, and track your progress;
  • to send you service messages (for example session reminders or timetable changes);
  • to tell you about programs, challenges and offers we think you'll like (you can opt out at any time; see section 4);
  • to understand how our website is used and measure our advertising; and
  • to meet our legal, insurance and record-keeping obligations.

We won't use or disclose your information for any other purpose unless you consent, you'd reasonably expect it, or the law requires or allows it (APP 6).

4. Direct marketing

We may contact you by SMS, email, phone or social media about our programs. Every marketing email or SMS will tell you how to opt out, or you can simply ask us. We don't sell your personal information.

5. Who we share it with

We share personal information only as needed with:

  • our coaches and staff, and our sister gym (Knight Fitness Morayfield) where you train across locations;
  • service providers that help us run the business, such as website hosting, online forms and booking, member management and payment platforms, messaging and email tools, and analytics and advertising providers (for example Google and Meta);
  • professional advisers such as our accountant, lawyer or insurer; and
  • emergency services or medical practitioners in an emergency, or government bodies where the law requires it.

These providers may only use your information to provide their service to us.

6. Overseas disclosure

Some of our service providers store or process data outside Australia, including in the United States and other countries where their cloud services operate. Where we disclose information overseas we take reasonable steps to make sure it is handled in line with the APPs (APP 8).

7. Cookies, analytics and advertising

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies, including Google Analytics 4 and the Meta Pixel, to understand how visitors use the site and to measure and improve our advertising (for example, counting when an enquiry is sent). These tools collect information about your device and browsing, and may link it to accounts you hold with those companies under their own privacy policies. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, use Google's Analytics opt-out add-on, and manage ad preferences in your Google and Meta account settings. Embedded content (such as Google Maps, YouTube and Vimeo videos, and our booking widgets) may also set cookies when you use it.

8. How we keep it secure

We take reasonable steps to protect personal information from misuse, interference, loss and unauthorised access, change or disclosure (APP 11). This includes using reputable providers with access controls, limiting staff access to what they need, and keeping paper forms secure. When we no longer need information, we take reasonable steps to destroy or de-identify it, unless the law requires us to keep it.

9. Accessing and correcting your information

You can ask for access to the personal information we hold about you, and ask us to correct it if it's inaccurate, out of date, incomplete or misleading (APPs 12 and 13). Contact us using the details below. We'll respond within a reasonable time, usually 30 days. If we refuse a request, we'll tell you why in writing and how to complain.

10. Data breaches

If a data breach is likely to cause serious harm, we'll follow the Notifiable Data Breaches scheme where it applies to us, including notifying affected people and the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner (OAIC).

11. Questions and complaints

If you have a question, or think we've mishandled your personal information, please contact us first:

Knight Fitness Lawnton, 664 Gympie Road, Lawnton QLD 4501

Phone: 0452 519 877

Email: info@knightfitness.com.au

We'll acknowledge your complaint and aim to resolve it within 30 days. If you're not satisfied with our response, you can contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner at oaic.gov.au or on 1300 363 992.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The current version will always be on this page, with the date it was last updated.
